title: Minority rights & right to property
quote: Every FR is a constitutional right, but not every constitutional right is an FR

boxes.title: Articles 29-30
head: Provision
What it says
rows: All minorities, ==**religious or linguistic**==, establish & administer educational institutions; "**Charter of Education Rights**"
**44th Amendment, 1978**: compensation on acquisition must not abrogate Art. 30 right
Mother-tongue instruction at primary stage (⚠ IYB misprint "360A")

boxes.title: Who is a minority?
items: Unit = **State** (**T.M.A. Pai**): numerical inferiority, non-dominant, distinct identity
**NCM**: statutory, **NCM Act, 1992**; minority = notified by Centre
Art. 30 not absolute: State regulates standards, not minority character
RTE **25% quota** not for minority schools (**Pramati, 2014**)

items.what: ==**44th Amendment**==: deleted 19(1)(f), 31 → **Art. 300A**, Part XII, Ch. IV

boxes.title: Article 300A & LARR 2013
items: **All persons**; protects against executive, not legislation
**LARR Act, 2013** replaced Act of **1894**; SIA mandatory
Compensation **4x** rural, **2x** urban; unused land back after **5 years**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: A-R pair: property = ==legal right under **300A**, Part XII== + **44th Amendment, 1978**
PYQ G1 2019 key said "Article 300" → correct is **Art. 300A**
"Minority" undefined in Constitution and NCM Act
Current: Kerala **Malayalam Bhasha Bill** vs Kannada minority, **Kasaragod**
